s1.syndrome_frame: Pituitary dysfunction with visual and neurological deficits
salient_findings: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass
key_facts: 2-month history of bitemporal hemianopia and left labial numbness
Right abducens nerve palsy on examination
Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling of the pituitary body and stalk
7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI
Loss of the posterior pituitary bright spot on T1-weighted images

shortlist.label: IgG4-related hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum IgG4 and pituitary MRI findings consistent with hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary dysfunction and visual deficits consistent with lymphocytic hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
shortlist.why_kept: Pituitary MRI showing diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass, consistent with granulomatous hypophysitis

shortlist.label: Pituitary adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: 7-mm poorly enhancing mass in the right anterior lobe on pituitary MRI, consistent with a pituitary adenoma

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated serum IgG4 and systemic imaging findings, including a nodular lesion in the left lung field, raising suspicion for systemic sarcoidosis

raw.rationale: Elevated serum IgG4 levels, pituitary MRI findings of diffuse swelling and a poorly enhancing mass, and the presence of a nodular lesion in the lung field suggestive of systemic IgG4-related disease, all support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Lymphocytic hypophysitis
rejected.why: Lack of specific markers or findings unique to lymphocytic hypophysitis

rejected.label: Granulomatous hypophysitis
rejected.why: No granulomatous changes mentioned in the provided information

rejected.label: Pituitary adenoma
rejected.why: The presence of a 7-mm mass could suggest an adenoma, but the clinical and laboratory context, including elevated IgG4 and systemic findings, points more towards an inflammatory process

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: While sarcoidosis can cause hypopituitarism and has systemic manifestations, the specific elevation of IgG4 and the pattern of organ involvement do not strongly support this diagnosis
